landing.heroTitle: Every person deserves a voice that keeps up with their life.
landing.heroBody: AAC apps turn taps, switches, or gaze into spoken language — at home, in therapy, and in class. Voxa is a modern communication board with motor planning, CVI-friendly themes, AI-assisted predictions, switch scanning, visual schedules, and secure cloud sync — designed so families start free and institutions scale with confidence.
landing.whyChangingList1: Reduces frustration when speech alone is not enough
landing.whyChangingList2: Supports language development, not just request-and-response
landing.whyChangingList3: Builds independence for meals, play, medical visits, and friendships
landing.whyChangingList4: Gives caregivers and clinicians a shared, evidence-aligned tool
landing.whyChangingNote: Research consistently shows early, robust AAC access improves communication outcomes — not delays speech.
landing.humanRightBody: Digital AAC replaces paper boards with speech output, vocabulary that grows with the user, and access methods matched to physical ability. Voxa focuses on what practitioners and families ask for most: stable motor plans, visually accessible layouts, and tools that work offline when the network does not.
landing.demoCtaBody: Explore core vocabulary with symbols, literacy keyboard, visual schedules, and access modes (switch scan + touch guard) — no signup required.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Always free for individual parents. Institutional plans fund secure hosting and analytics for teams.
landing.parentsBody: Forever free for individual families supporting one communicator at home.
landing.familyBody: More boards and shared editing for siblings, grandparents, and co-parents.
landing.instBody: Paid plans for organizations that need compliance, roles, and aggregate usage insight by communicator — without exposing private message content.
landing.footerCtaTitle: Start where you are. Grow when you need to.
landing.footerCtaBody: Try the demo as a visitor, create a free parent account in minutes, or talk with us about rolling Voxa out across your organization.

motor.title: Motor planning first
motor.body: Core words stay in fixed locations so users build muscle memory — the same principle behind leading dedicated AAC devices.

cvi.title: CVI & access modes
cvi.body: High-contrast themes, switch scanning, and eye-dwell support mean the same board adapts to cortical visual impairment and different physical access.

ai.title: AI that respects consent
ai.body: Optional predictions speed multi-word messages; families control AI consent, and institutional policies can be enforced centrally.

obf.title: Open Board Format
obf.body: Import and export OBF to collaborate with SLPs and migrate from other apps without lock-in.

offline.title: Offline-ready
offline.body: Boards cache locally so communication continues on unreliable school Wi‑Fi or during travel.

janua.title: Janua identity
janua.body: One MADFAM sign-in across Voxa and partner tools — fewer passwords for caregivers and staff.

firstMessage.title: You just spoke with Voxa
firstMessage.body: AAC gives non-speaking and minimally speaking people a voice for everyday needs, relationships, and learning. Create a free parent account to save boards, sync across devices, and personalize vocabulary.

templates.title: Four starter templates in the full app
templates.body: Core 47, Core 100, literacy keyboard, and visual schedules ship as editable templates — plus OBF/Gridset/Snap/TouchChat import in the SLP editor.

access.title: Clinical access modes built in
access.body: Switch scanning with auditory cues, touch guard overlays, eye-dwell simulation, and touch-release activation — configurable per communicator in Settings.

institution.title: Usage insight for every communicator
institution.body: Institutional plans add team roles, unlimited boards, full AI, and high-level usage reports — see engagement by student or patient while protecting individual privacy.

communicator.routineComplete: Routine complete — tap Clear to start over

settings.title: Accessibility
settings.scanHintNone: Hardware: Space/Enter selects; Tab/Arrow Right advances. Bluetooth switches and USB adapters that emulate a keyboard work automatically. Gamepad button 0 selects; button 1 advances.
settings.scanHintGroup: Select a group, then a cell. Hardware keys and gamepad buttons work the same as single-level scan.
settings.auditoryBeepHint: Play a short tone on each scan step
settings.pauseWhileSpeakingHint: Hold scan step during TTS or recordings
settings.touchGuardHelp: Semi-transparent overlays block accidental touches outside button holes.
settings.gazeHintTobii: Lab inject: window.__voxaInjectGaze(x, y) or dispatch voxa:gaze CustomEvent.
settings.gazeHintPointer: Hold pointer over a button to activate (simulates eye dwell).
settings.symbolDiversityHint: Default for new person symbols in the editor. Per-button overrides remain available.
settings.whisperHint: Add words to the message bar without TTS
settings.boardDisplayHint: Saved with this vocabulary board. Overrides the device settings above when checked.
settings.editorPinConfigured: A PIN is required to enter Editor or Admin role on this device.
settings.editorPinUnset: Set a PIN so only clinicians can edit vocabulary.
settings.pinRemoveConfirm: Remove editor PIN? Editor mode will open without a prompt.
